question: A proton moves with speed $4.0 \times 10^5\text{ m s}^{-1}$ perpendicular to the earth’s magnetic field of magnitude $4.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ T}$. Calculate the magnetic force on the proton and the radius of the circular path followed by it. Take $q = 1.6 \times 10^{-19}\text{ C}$ and $m = 1.67 \times 10^{-27}\text{ kg}$.

options.C: $F=0$ because motion is perpendicular to field, and $r=104\text{ m}$.
